title: VibeCheck: Assessing the Quality of LLM-Generated Unit Tests: A Multi-agent Empirical Study across Heterogeneous Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2609.05978v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based IDE agents are increasingly used to generate repository-grounded unit tests, yet common evaluations often rely on execution success or coverage. These metrics can miss deeper quality issues such as weak assertions, missing edge cases, poor isolation, and limited maintainability. This paper presents VibeCheck, an empirical study of unit test generation across 15 student-developed Python and JavaScript/TypeScript repositories. We evaluate Kiro, Antigravity, and Cursor with Claude Sonnet 4.5 as the underlying agent, under repository-only, zero-shot conditions using a five-dimensional rubric covering runnability, assertion strength, logic and edge-case coverage, isolation/determinism, and maintainability. We also apply leave-one-out cross-agent peer evaluation to compare tools and identify failure patterns. translated_title: VibeCheck：评估大语言模型生成单元测试的质量：跨异构代码仓库的多智能体实证研究
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的IDE智能体正日益被用于生成基于代码仓库的单元测试，然而常见的评估方法往往依赖于执行成功或覆盖率。这些指标可能会遗漏更深层次的质量问题，例如断言薄弱、缺失边界情况、隔离性差以及可维护性有限。本文提出了VibeCheck，这是一项针对15个学生开发的Python和JavaScript/TypeScript代码仓库的单元测试生成实证研究。我们在仅提供仓库信息、零样本的条件下，使用涵盖可运行性、断言强度、逻辑与边界情况覆盖、隔离性/确定性以及可维护性的五维评估标准，评估了以Claude Sonnet 4.5为底层模型的Kiro、Antigravity和Cursor三款工具。我们还应用留一法跨智能体同行评估来比较各工具并识别失败模式。结果显示存在明显的执行充分性差距：生成的测试通常可以运行，但经常缺乏强断言以及……
tldr: 该论文提出VibeCheck实证研究，通过五维评估标准发现基于LLM的IDE智能体生成的单元测试虽然大多可运行，但在断言强度、边界情况覆盖、隔离性和可维护性等深层质量维度上存在明显不足。
